interpretation.test: Wilcoxon signed-rank paired test. Alternative 'greater' = H1: oracle > baseline.
interpretation.effect_size_convention: Cohen's d_paired = mean(oracle - baseline) / std. |d|>0.2 small, 0.5 medium, 0.8 large.
interpretation.h_2026_204_rq1_threshold: Oracle (B8) vs fixed smoothing (B2): NetGain median Delta >= +10% (명세 §11 Go 5). Rule-based (B5) vs fixed smoothing (B2): median Delta >= +5%, p<0.05, Cohen's d >= 0.3.
